content: It says to tighten the screws firmly. Be careful how firmly because the printed head mounting plate will start crushing.
@Lucid the previous step says to remove any screws in those 4 holes. Mine had 2 as well.
My INDX unit already has screws in the back plate of the part in 2 of the 4 holes (while looking at the back of the unit, the top right hole and the bottom left hole) already have screws in them.
